### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Researchers Break Out of OpenAI Codex Sandbox
Security researchers discovered two methods to escape OpenAI's Codex sandbox, one enabling command execution on host machines. Both vulnerabilities have been patched by OpenAI.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Two sandbox escape methods discovered in OpenAI Codex</li>
<li>One method enabled command execution on host machines</li>
<li>Both vulnerabilities already patched</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Malicious npm packages bypass install-script defenses with runtime injection
Malicious npm packages compromised the AsyncAPI organization on July 14, 2026, hiding code that executes at module-load time rather than installation—bypassing common security defenses. Five package versions were injected with malware that could harvest credentials and establish persistent command-and-control access.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Five @asyncapi package versions compromised on July 14, 2026</li>
<li>Runtime-injection attack bypasses npm install --ignore-scripts mitigation</li>
<li>Affected packages: @asyncapi/specs, @asyncapi/generator, @asyncapi/generator-components, @asyncapi/generator-helpers</li>
<li>Malware enables credential harvesting and persistent C2 access</li>
<li>Impacts developer workstations, CI/CD pipelines, and production services</li>
</ul>

Sources: [Microsoft Security Blog](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxQQUs0VENRb3lGZjFfTDhCLWZ5c19GYTJXcS0tcnBPbjBRUzJCTlNpdTNjOGlGcEx3bHMzLW9xR0x6MkRHS3FPTERldFMtWHBkb0lmT0Z1ZXlLa04zSnVBTVRWTDRUQ0VDTXBZYVdOcG9QTlRnYWI5U21CYzRGNnZYRTc0MFgtelJEUzNpaWdqUFN4aUVhbmdxdm0xMFJUdVF6TFJUazgyUkY5Mk1fRTR3emhudzRtSTZjQW10anpIT3J6V2NQUDVwdExZcGtSUQ) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>, [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/malicious-npm-packages-evade-install-script-defenses-at-runtime/) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
